subject: maths
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What is the value of sin 90°?
questions.explain: sin 90° = 1 is a standard exact value.

questions.q: What is the exact value of cos 60°?
questions.explain: cos 60° = 1/2 is a standard exact value.

questions.explain: tan 0° = 0 since the opposite side is 0.

questions.q: What is the exact value of sin 45°?
questions.explain: sin 45° = √2/2 (equivalently 1/√2) is a standard exact value.

questions.q: A right-angled triangle has adjacent = 10 and an angle of 45°. The opposite side = 10 × tan 45°. What is the opposite?

questions.explain: A bearing of 270° measured clockwise from North points due West.

questions.explain: With opposite and adjacent you use tan, then inverse tan to get the angle.

questions.q: To find a missing side when you know an angle and the hypotenuse and need the adjacent, which ratio is used?
questions.explain: Adjacent and hypotenuse are linked by cos.
